expires_today.title: Urban Shadows Physical Collection
expires_today.long_description:
Dive into the supernatural demimonde of Urban Shadows with this bundle of physical game accessories! Now you can level up your literal tabletop with a physical copy of Urban Shadows: Second Edition, a dice tray and pack of five pairs of dice engraved with the city’s four powerful political Circles, and a Master of Ceremonies screen to hide all the exciting twists and turns from prying eyes. Journey through a city where nothing is as it seems, and forces both mundane and supernatural vie for power over the skyline of shadow! Grab these Urban Shadows accessories at the price of your choosing, and support Tabletop Gaymers with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before December 31st, 2026.

expires_today.title: Double Fine Publisher Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
Get the best of Double Fine in this bundle of the video game publisher’s greatest hits! Embrace your psychic powers and battle inside the minds of your enemies in Psychonauts! Explore a fantasy world with a heavy metal twist and save the universe with the power of rock in Brütal Legend! Take control of your fate with two teenagers from fantastically different worlds in the gorgeously hand-animated Broken Age! Explore all of these games and more in this bundle from Double Fine! You choose what you pay, and support Double Fine’s indie game making charity Day of the Devs with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 6th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Serenity Forge Emotional Impact Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
Get in touch with your sensitive side with this bundle of games from Serenity Forge! These emotional journeys will lead you through layered family dramas and post-apocalyptic deserts where humanity is the only thing we have left. Travel through a wasteland full of mutants in search of family in LISA: the Painful and LISA: The Joyful! Discover what immortality truly costs in the eerie RPG Death’s Gambit: Afterlife! Search through your childhood house to find your missing family in Gone Home! Exciting adventures and moving storytelling await in this bundle of the best from Serenity Forge. Grab them all now at the price of your choosing, and support Children’s Miracle Network Hospitals with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before May 6th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Castles & Crusades RPG Experience
expires_today.long_description: Journey through a fantasy world of your own making with this bundle of Castles & Crusades TTRPG rulebooks and resources! Learn the rules of the game and design your characters with the Players Handbook, populate your fantasy land with monsters, artifacts, treasure, and NPCs, and collect digital editions of the White and Black box sets, complete with their own storylines and adventures! Dive into a fantastical adventure of your own design with this giant bundle of Castles & Crusades! Get these TTRPG resources now at the price of your choosing, and support Children’s Miracle Network with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Twisted Trilogies and Terrors: Dark Visual Novels
expires_today.description: Twisted trilogies and terrifying tales await.
expires_today.long_description:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

Sink your teeth into the Twisted Trilogies and Terrors: Dark Visual Novel Bundle, a seasonal collection of scary games! Choose from a trio of Spirit Hunter titles, including the critically acclaimed Death Mark II. Spooky supernatural studies are in session within the halls of Tokyo’s Konoehara Academy, and it’s your duty as a Spirit Doctor to cleanse the prestigious academy’s classrooms with your partner. Or try Class of '09, a trilogy of anti-visual novel games where you play as a beautiful heroine who causes chaos for every suitor who tries to gain your affection. Plus, your purchase helps support Movember!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 30th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Gals and Pals: PQube Japanese Games
expires_today.description: Explore PQube’s gorgeous girls of gaming
expires_today.long_description:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

Fall into an intimate bundle of spicy Japanese games with the Gals and Pals Bundle published by PQube! Turn up the heat in Gal*Gun Returns, a colorfully reimagined version of the first game that started it all, the sensual sequel Gal*Gun 2, or the action-packed Gal*Gun: Double Peace! Massage your romantic impulses with these rail-shooters of beautiful bubbly girls, and fulfill your euphoric fantasies where bullets have been replaced with enchanting pheromone shots! Unwrap steamy gal-pal fun for a price you choose and help support Cool Effect with your purchase.

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 30th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Indie Fighters
expires_today.long_description:
You’d better brush up on your combat skills if you want to take on these indie fighting games! Harness the power of the four elements to clobber your opponents to dust in Rivals of Aether II! Get a kick out of a modern fighting game with a retro arcade-inspired aesthetic in Pocket Bravery! Go back to basics and battle your enemies using just two buttons in the simple yet effective Divekick! Explore even more fighting game fun in this bundle of brawlers—you choose what you pay, and every purchase supports the rare disease research organization Raiden Science Foundation!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 28th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: The Complete Higgsfield AI Video Creation Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Learn how to optimize your production cycle with The Complete Higgsfield AI Video Creation Bundle. Higgsfield replaces your AI stack with one powerful platform to create videos, images, music, and more using 50+ premium models. This curated collection will help you build video games, add polish to your YouTube videos, and much more with specialized learning courses like Build Faceless YouTube Channels with Higgsfield and Build Game Trailers with Higgsfield AI and DaVinci Resolve. Learn to leverage the most powerful creation tools and help support Girls Who Code with your purchase!

Keys expire. All titles must be redeemed by November 7, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Candela Obscura by Darrington Press & Friends
expires_tomorrow.description: Get The Descent, The Beast in the Binding and more!
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Immerse yourself in paranormal mysteries with this bundle of Darrington Press’s Candela Obscura TTRPG ebooks! Enter the Fairelands and join a secret society of the occult with the Candela Obscura Core Rulebook, which includes detailed descriptions of the turn-of-the-century urban horror-fantasy setting, example assignments, and guides for preparing your own adventures! Kick off your campaign with collections of multi-session assignments like Horrors of the Fairelands, The Bleeding Edge, The Woman in Red, and more! Dive into a fully realized world of magick and mystery and give your next tabletop adventure the spooky edge it’s been missing! Grab this bundle of TTRPG books and resources for the price of your choosing, and support the Critical Role Foundation with your purchase!

Keys are redeemable through DriveThruRPG.

expires_tomorrow.title: Dungeon Adventures! - 3D Printable Miniatures & Scenery
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Your campaign is as real as you make it, so why not give it some life? Fill your dungeons with characters and scenery with this bundle of 3D printable miniatures from Hayland Terrain and Warp Miniatures! Get over 90 software files for absolutely everything you need—from giant ants and bats to rock elementals, spooky sewer entrances, tombs, market stalls, and more! Build your environments and fill them with characters, creatures, and tons of detail to give your players a whole world of adventure! Grab this bundle at the brice of your choice, and support Make-A-Wish with your purchase!

expires_within_72h.title: Godot Game Development Mega Bundle - 20 Complete Game Templates
expires_within_72h.long_description:
Get ready for Godot to change your development cycle. Enjoy unlimited downloads of genre-specific templates from the pros at Mammoth. Tackle full projects with starter kits, ready-to-use prompts, and approachable workflows. Explore the Vertical Journey template and build your own blocky 3D climbing game that uses Godot 4 to easily port to mobile or desktop. Or create your own card games with the TriPeaks Solitaire bundle and dazzle your players with timeless fun. Pay what you want for an epic Mega Bundle of commercially licensed game templates, and help support Girls Who Code today!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before November 8, 2027.
